designSummary: Branch A: census of about 23,000 students from the register with a completeness correction. Branch B: two-stage cluster survey of 24 schools and 30 students per school.
sampleSize: Branch A needs no sample: all students are included and precision is limited by register completeness, not sampling. Branch B: to estimate coverage near 70 percent within 5 percentage points with a design effect of 2.1, about 680 students are needed (1.96 squared times 0.21 divided by 0.0025, times 2.1); 24 schools of 30 students (720) allow for about 6 percent non-response. Comparing the most and least deprived quintiles within the survey will be imprecise and is reported descriptively.
primaryAnalysis: Proportion up to date on 2026-06-30 with 95 percent confidence interval: branch A with the completeness correction and a sensitivity analysis without it; branch B with survey weights and cluster-robust intervals.
secondaryAnalysis: Coverage by deprivation quintile and by school language share; consent return by school and delivery route; each vaccine separately.
missingData: Branch A: students not found in the register are counted as not vaccinated in a sensitivity analysis and as missing in the main one. Branch B: non-responding students are compared with responders on school and grade.
multiplicity: One primary outcome; stratified estimates are descriptive.
software: R with survey weighting for branch B.
overfittingGuards: No modelling beyond two pre-specified stratifiers
Branch chosen by data access, not by results
Analysis plan fixed before any data arrive
summary: Census or cluster survey, each with a single primary estimate and descriptive stratified results.
